args.title: Fix password reset email link to use correct base URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Replace the hardcoded BASE_URL fallback "http://localhost:3000" with a more appropriate production URL or configuration approach, so that the password reset email sends links that work outside development environments. This will fix the issue where the password reset link points to localhost, making the link valid for users receiving the email.
